predeclaration: Exactly one predeclared native edge-evidence coverage analysis (node/edge/evidence counts; native source, UNKNOWN and counterevidence channels). No knowledge-effectiveness or relation-truth claim is emitted. Separately versioned from the relational analysis.
resultBinding: resultSha256 is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of {claims, counterevidence, coverage}; the candidate never carries a digest of itself.
nonclaims: No knowledge-effectiveness or relation-truth claim is emitted by this analysis; claims are structural node/edge/evidence coverage with UNKNOWN preserved and never collapsed.
A candidate is authority-free: it never promotes, mutates, executes, or publishes, and gains no capability or effect.
